title: Familiar Tales
subtitle: App-driven fantasy storybook campaign where magical familiars nurture and protect a royal child
tagline: Little heroes. Big responsibility. An unforgettable fairytale.
loreSummary: Entrusted by your wizard master with the survival of the realm's rightful heir, four magical familiars must raise a displaced princess from infancy to adulthood. Guide her path through enchanted forests, craft survival tools, and confront wicked tyrants in a living, voice-narrated storybook.
roadmapTitle: 🗺️ Tale of the Princess & Era Roadmap
keyFeatures: Fully narrated browser and mobile companion app delivering rich voice acting and dynamic story branches
Evolutionary deck-crafting mechanics where familiars customize their card pools and build cooperative synergies
Three distinct life eras charting the child's development from vulnerable baby to courageous heroine
Branching moral choices where how you nurture the princess permanently shapes her personality and fate
